summary: Phase 1 completed (deprecation + infrastructure), Phase 2 blocked on core model-theoretic argument requiring Reynolds model surgery or omega-chain analysis to prove chronicle_gap_contradiction
blockers: chronicle_gap_contradiction sorry requires proving that the chronicle omega-chain construction never produces Dedekind gaps. The abstract MCS axioms (Prior-UZ, Prior-SZ, C4, C5, Z1) are provably insufficient -- the Z+Z counterexample with constant predicates satisfies all axioms but has a gap. The proof needs Reynolds Lemmas 6-13 (model surgery, ~400-600 lines) or direct omega-chain structural analysis (~200-400 lines).
